RIGHT-CLICK use the bones on a fire. You can either make one yourself, or use them on the fire south of Tai Bwo Wannai.

Go back to Tiadeche located north of fairy ring DKP and use the crafting manual on him.

Use a poisoned spear on Tamayu.
Go on a hunt with Tamayu.
Use your monkey corpse on Tamayu to have him skin it for you.
